The case is the original physical capability, not beautiful bond-like pictures: calibrated force response and modelling establish the inference, and a common qPlus/tip invention chronology must justify all three people. This serious scope condition remains unresolved, but does not negate the mature measurement advance. Clocks are the leading fallback, then DMFT, circuit QED and exact work/fluctuation relations. I judge original discovery and verified reach rather than visible support or current performance, and favor these mature advances over no award.
